title: Hotel California
lyrics:
[00:00.000] 作词 : The Eagles
[00:01.000] 作曲 : The Eagles
[00:18.050]
[02:13.845]On a dark desert highway
[02:17.301]Cool wind in my hair
[02:20.604]Warm smell of colitas
[02:23.315]Rising up through the air
[02:26.808]Up ahead in the distance
[02:30.057]I saw a shimmering light
[02:33.311]My head grew heavy and my sight grew dim
[02:36.343]I had to stop for the night
[02:39.313]There she stood in the doorway
[02:42.802]I heard the mission bell
[02:45.815]And I was thinking to myself
[02:48.310]This could be heaven and this could be hell
[02:52.308]Then she lit up a candle
[02:55.559]And she showed me the way
[02:58.793]There were voices down the corridor
[03:01.812]I thought I heard them say
[03:05.322]Welcome to the Hotel California
[03:10.799]Such a lovely place
[03:12.555]Such a lovely place
[03:13.809]Such a lovely face
[03:17.302]Plenty of room at the Hotel California
[03:23.821]Any time of year
[03:25.306]Any time of year
[03:26.563]You can find it here
[03:30.810]Her mind is Tiffany-twisted
[03:33.813]She got the Mercedes-Benz
[03:37.047]She got a lot of pretty boys
[03:40.295]That she calls friends
[03:43.548]How they dance in the courtyard
[03:46.057]Sweet summer sweat
[03:49.814]Some dance to remember
[03:53.061]Some dance to forget
[03:56.152]So I called up the captain
[03:59.660]Please bring me my wine
[04:02.358]He said we haven't had that spirit here since 1969
[04:09.285]And still those voices are calling from far away
[04:15.675]Wake you up in the middle of the night
[04:18.739]Just to hear them say
[04:21.934]Welcome to the Hotel California
[04:27.734]Such a lovely place
[04:28.945]Such a lovely place
[04:30.991]Such a lovely face
[04:34.446]They live in it up at the Hotel California
[04:40.442]What a nice surprise
[04:41.695]What a nice surprise
[04:43.443]Bring your alibis
[04:48.025]Mirrors on the ceiling
[04:51.023]The pink champagne on ice
[04:53.090]And she said we are all just prisoners here
[04:57.348]of our own device
[05:00.890]And in the master's chambers
[05:03.835]They gathered for the feast
[05:07.083]They stab it with their steely knives
[05:09.846]But they just can't kill the beast
[05:13.930]Last thing I remember
[05:16.038]I was running for the door
[05:20.288]I had to find the passage back
[05:22.796]To the place I was before
[05:26.526]Relax said the night man
[05:29.289]We are programmed to receive
[05:33.036]You can check out any time you like
[05:35.280]But you can never leave
